challenge.method: Tested substitution of the BY-SA 4.0 record, the 3.0 Unported edition, the linked deed and the canonical English URL. Checked crossRef.match for a possible conflict.
challenge.results: The ID, licenseText section 1(g) and exact citation all retain NC and SA at 4.0. Neither the deed nor the .en URL is the cited string. The crossRef.match value is the string “false”. The record still explicitly cites the page. Its citation supports documentary correspondence only.

limitations: The finding concerns a citation in one generated file at one release. It establishes no equivalence of texts, translation, adaptation, project-wide applicability, downstream grant or redistribution right.

The publisher digest measures the acquired /legalcode response. Its canonical /legalcode.en declaration supplies no byte comparison. SPDX deprecation, the SPDX release tag and Index maintenance each have a separate source.
